shadow:
Watch where the mind reaches when a mood lands. A bad feeling arrives and within seconds it has a cause attached, the food, the weather, the thing someone said. A good one arrives and the mind grabs for what produced it so the feeling can be kept. This reaching is so quick it never registers as a choice. It feels like the truth of what happened.

Victimisation is the habit of putting the source of how you feel somewhere outside you. It looks like clear seeing. It is closer to a story that keeps writing itself, because every time the story runs it gets more believable.

Most people treat the heavy feeling as proof that life is against them, and try to fix the outside until it lifts. That is the snag. The trap is not the circumstance. It is the longing underneath, the one that wants the low to end and the high to stay. That hunger never gets fed for long.

But the same habit holds its own way out. Nothing here needs fixing. Once a person sees the net is hand-tied, the hands can stop. That is not technique. It is just noticing the prison has a door.
repressive: Some people meet it by complaining inward. A low running commentary on how things go wrong, kept private, never aimed at anyone. It feels like honesty about a hard life. It quietly keeps the hard life in place.
reactive: Others meet it by blaming outward. They find the person or the system at fault and fire the charge at it. It feels like standing up for themselves. Each time the arrow lands, the story of being wronged gets one more proof.
gift:
Stop asking the outside to change first and a quiet rearrangement begins. The mood still comes, the low days still come, but the reaching for a cause loosens its grip. What opens behind it is freedom.

Freedom here is not escape. Nobody sells the house and walks off to a cave. It is lighter than that and stranger. It is the weight coming off feelings that were never as solid as they seemed. A mood passes through and is allowed to pass, without a verdict pinned to it.

This cannot be forced. Push at freedom directly and you get another agenda, another thing to achieve, the victim wearing a calmer face. It arrives more like a slow unlearning. You keep living an ordinary life, the job, the bills, the people, and inside that life the holding-on quietly thins out. The search for relief turns almost playful. Still there, still longing, but no longer desperate about it.

And the more a person lives this way, the more life shows them the exact spots where they are still caught. Each one seen is one fewer. The lightness builds on itself, which is how it reaches toward what comes next.
siddhi:
Freedom stops being something a person practices and becomes the air they live in. The two ends of the spectrum carry the same word, and that is not an accident. The Gift and the highest state are one thing seen at different distances.

Here there is no longer a self standing apart, taking the feeling personally, asking who did this. A feeling moves and there is just the moving of it, like weather over open ground. Nothing to defend, nothing to pin down.

Think of the dragonfly. It spends years underwater as a nymph, a sharp small hunter with no notion of sky. Then it climbs the stem, and the same water it lived in pumps its wings open and takes flight.

From up here a person can look back at the long underwater years. The victim story, the complaining, the blame, all of it was the water. It was not failure and it was not waste. It was the element the wings needed.
